vetSays.line: 🛡️ Piper, Tomas, Deirdre, Ciro and Fatima met them at the door — 5 put down. Piper, Tomas, Deirdre, Ciro, Fatima are hurt.
🛡️ Piper, Tomas, Ciro and Fatima met them at the door — 4 put down. Piper, Tomas, Ciro, Fatima are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Piper just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ciro, Ursula and Tom met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Ciro, Ursula, Tom are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mara just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Piper just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nino just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Piper, Deirdre, Ursula, Tom and Nino met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Piper, Deirdre, Ursula, Tom, Nino are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jorge just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jorge met them at the door — 1 put down. Jorge is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pawan just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Yorgelis just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jorge, Yorgelis and Pawan met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Jorge, Pawan are hurt.
🛡️ Yorgelis, Antonia and Maitê met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Antonia didn't come back. Yorgelis, Maitê are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
